# SEA HAG AUNTIE

SEA HAG AUNTIE CR 7
A lurking shape leers from the brine, lidless eyes glaring
from a tangle cloud of sodden hair. Her long claws twitch
with the shifting current.
AC 15 (Natural Armor) Initiative +5 (15)
HP 151 (18d8 + 72) Size Medium
Speed 30 ft., Swim 40 ft. Type Fey
MOD SAVE MOD SAVE MOD SAVE
Str 19 +4 +4 Dex 15 +2 +2 Con 18 +4 +7
Int 15 +2 +2 Wis 13 +1 +4 Cha 18 +4 +7
Skills Deception +7, Insight +4, Perception +4, Stealth +8
Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 14
Languages Aquan, Common, Giant
Drives Keep Grudges, Punish Disrespect, Sow Mistrust
XP 2,900 Proficiency Bonus +3
Traits
Illusory Mimicry. The hag can perfectly mimic the voice
and appearance of any Beast or Humanoid that is Cursed
by or Indebted to it.
Coven Craft. While at least two allies with this trait are
within 30 feet of the hag, its Attack Rolls have Advantage
and creatures have Disadvantage on any saving throw
they make against effects it controls.
Actions
Multiattack. The hag makes two attacks, one of which it
can replace with a use of its Pilfered Spell, Seed Terror, or
Steal Passion.
Rotflesh Claw. Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13
(2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic
damage.
Pilfered Spell. The sea hag casts a spell of Level 3 or below
known by a creature Cursed by or Indebted to it, using
that creature’s spell slots.
Seed Terror. Illusory blight spreads from the hag in a 15-
foot Emanation, making flesh appear to sag and rot. Each
creature in the area must make a
Intelligence or Wisdom Saving Throw:
(Target’s Choice) DC 15. Failure: The creature is
Frightened for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
Steal Passion (Concentration). The hag tears a token from a
creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a Charisma
Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Cursed.
Failure by 5 or More: The hag can maintain this effect
without Concentration.
While Cursed in this way, the creature suffers one of the
following effects of the hag’s choice.
The creature can’t speak louder than a whisper, and can’t
cast spells of Level 1 or above.
The creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet and it can’t take
Bonus Actions or Reactions.
The creature has Disadvantage on any d20 Test that uses
Strength or Charisma.
Bilebrine (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell). Stinging brine
surges over a creature the hag can see within 60 feet,
forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15.
Failure: 22 (5d8) Acid damage plus 22 (5d8) Necrotic
damage. Success: Half damage.
A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is
infected with Merthirst.
Bonus Actions
Drowner’s Dive. The hag moves up to half its Swim Speed,
then can attempt to Hide if it has at least Half Cover.
Sargassum Grasp. A tangle of seaweed blooms to envelop
a submerged creature within 30 feet, forcing it to make a
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature
is Restrained until the end of its next turn (escape DC 15)
and dragged 15 feet in a direction of the hag’s choice.
Death Glare (Only if Bloodied). One Frightened creature
within 30 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC
15. Failure: The creature is Stunned until the end of its
next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The creature drops to 0
Hit Points.
Reactions
Courage to Dread. Trigger: A creature within 30 feet
succeeds on an Intelligence or Wisdom Saving Throw.
Response: The hag deals 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage to it.

## Referenced definitions from the same PDF

Hag Debts
A creature that has made an unfulfilled promise to a hag, or
one that removes a Curse created by a hag, becomes
Indebted to the hag.
A creature Indebted to a hag becomes psychically
connected to it. The hag can telepathically communicate
with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through
its senses at will. Once per day, the hag can force an
indebted creature to reroll d20 Test, taking the second result.

Merthirst
A creature infected with merthirst loses all appetite, its eyes
become bloodshot, and a crust of pale salt gradually
accumulates around its nose and lips. It can keep solid food
down only if washed down with sea water.

selection.name: SEA HAG AUNTIE Automation
selection.notes: Sea Hag Auntie (CR 7 fey, actor-1) has no source feature matching any automatic catalog capability. Every special consequence is source-complete GM adjudication: Illusory Mimicry is description-only; Coven Craft, Pilfered Spell, Seed Terror, Steal Passion, Bilebrine/Merthirst, Drowner’s Dive, Sargassum Grasp, Death Glare and Courage to Dread are bound as separate gm-manual rules with their complete source rules quoted for review. Native attack, save, damage, DC and item/recharge data remain in the formally generated Items and are never restated in parameters. No legendary actions or legendary resistance pool exist, so legendaryRecovery is empty.

gmSteps: GM confirms at least two allies with the Coven Craft trait are within 30 feet of the hag before any Attack Roll or opposed saving throw is resolved.
GM applies Advantage to the hag’s Attack Rolls and Disadvantage to saving throws against effects it controls while the condition is met, and ends both immediately when the condition is no longer met.
No automatic modifier, aura or toggle is executed by the engine.

rules.quote: The sea hag casts a spell of Level 3 or below
gmSteps: GM determines whether a creature is Cursed by or Indebted to the hag and which Level 3-or-below spell of that creature the hag casts.
GM confirms the spell is known by that creature and expends that creature’s spell slots for the casting, including Concentration where the chosen spell requires it.
GM otherwise resolves the chosen spell normally; the engine executes no spell selection, slot spending or curse/indebtedness check.

rules.quote: Frightened for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
gmSteps: GM places the 15-foot Emanation legally from the hag and selects every creature in the area as targets; the engine performs no area placement or targeting.
For each target, GM confirms the target’s choice of Intelligence or Wisdom for the DC 15 saving throw, then applies Frightened for 1 minute on a failure.
GM adjudicates the repeated save at the end of the affected creature’s turn and removes Frightened when that save succeeds; no automatic duration, save prompt or expiry is executed.
GM confirms the creature is within 5 feet, calls for the DC 15 Charisma saving throw, and applies the Cursed state on a failure.
GM tracks Concentration for the effect and, on a failure by 5 or more, records that the hag can maintain the effect without Concentration.

On each affected creature, GM chooses and applies exactly one of the three listed while-Cursed effects, and ends the whole effect according to the source; the engine applies no curse, choice, Concentration tracking or expiry.

GM uses the generated native save Activity: DC 15 Constitution saving throw against one creature the hag can see within 60 feet, with the native Acid and Necrotic damage applied and Half damage on a success.
GM confirms the Recharge 5-6 use.
If the damage reduces the creature to 0 Hit Points, GM applies the Merthirst infection using the referenced Merthirst definition; the engine applies no infection, disease state or recovery timing.

rules.quote: The hag moves up to half its Swim Speed,
gmSteps: GM moves the hag up to half its Swim Speed as a bonus action.
GM confirms the hag has at least Half Cover and adjudicates the attempt to Hide, including any resulting stealth result; the engine performs no movement, cover check or Hide roll.

rules.quote: is Restrained until the end of its next turn (escape DC 15)
gmSteps: GM confirms the target is a submerged creature within 30 feet and calls for the DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, GM applies Restrained until the end of the target’s next turn and resolves escape attempts at escape DC 15, ending Restrained when the creature escapes or the duration ends.
GM also drags the creature 15 feet in a direction of the hag’s choice; the engine performs no restraint, escape resolution, duration tracking or forced movement.

rules.quote: Failure: The creature is Stunned until the end of its
gmSteps: GM confirms the hag is Bloodied and that one Frightened creature is within 30 feet; if either prerequisite is not met, the feature cannot be used.
GM calls for the DC 15 Wisdom saving throw and, on a failure, applies Stunned until the end of that creature’s next turn, ending it then.
On a failure by 5 or more, GM instead drops the creature to 0 Hit Points; the engine executes no prerequisite check, stun, duration or drop-to-0 branch.

rules.quote: succeeds on an Intelligence or Wisdom Saving Throw.
gmSteps: GM confirms the trigger: a creature within 30 feet succeeded on an Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw, and confirms the hag uses its reaction.
GM applies the native 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage to that creature.
The engine does not detect the trigger, which remains a GM decision.

rules.quote: The hag can perfectly mimic the voice
gmSteps: GM determines whether a Beast or Humanoid is Cursed by or Indebted to the hag and adjudicates the mimicry of its voice and appearance; the engine applies no effect.
No automatic condition, branch or resource is executed for this description-only trait.

manualSteps: No implemented automatic capability (save-summon, turn-start-area, staged-corruption, threshold-ward, ward-break, save-failure-effect, status-lifecycle, gm-activity-lock) matches any Sea Hag Auntie feature, so none were selected and no automatic condition, summon, ward, staged marker or attack-hit lifecycle is created.

Seed Terror, Sargassum Grasp, Death Glare and Steal Passion carry save-based conditions (Frightened, Restrained, Stunned, Cursed) that are outside the closed save-failure-effect and status-lifecycle catalogs; their save DCs, abilities and damage remain in the native generated Items, and GM applies and ends all consequences by source.
Seed Terror’s and Steal Passion’s generated Items expose only a Utility Activity, so GM must place/select the area and targets manually and cannot rely on an automated area save.

Merthirst (Bilebrine) and Hag Debts (Cursed/Indebted prerequisites for Illusory Mimicry and Pilfered Spell) are source-defined conditions with no automatic state, duration or recovery; GM tracks them.

Death Glare’s Bloodied-and-Frightened prerequisites, its failure-by-5-or-more drop to 0 Hit Points, and Steal Passion’s failure-by-5 concentration exemption are conditional branches that must be adjudicated by GM.

Courage to Dread’s trigger (a creature succeeding on an Intelligence or Wisdom save) and Drowner’s Dive’s Half Cover Hide attempt are not detected or automated; only the native damage and utility Activities are available.
